flows: A version-1 wardrobe migrates without losing existing clothes; 16 labelled sample pieces are seeded exactly once.
Sample clothes generate multiple everyday, smart and cold-weather combinations, which can be saved.
Removing samples also removes dependent sample looks; personal clothing survives and samples do not return on reload.
Restoring the collection is idempotent and preserves personal clothing.
Privacy reset leaves an empty wardrobe after reload; samples return only through the explicit restore control.
